text:
- **Package installs:** every package install of ci.yml is bounded and retried. Ten steps call `bash .github/scripts/apt-install.sh <package>...` — `libfontconfig1-dev` in nine jobs (build-msrv, build-features-default, test-features-default, build-counter, clippy, doc, a11y, coverage and, since 2026-10-14-quality-gates, stand-repeat) and `python3-yaml` in `ci-scripts`, behind `python3 -c 'import yaml' ||` — and the script makes up to 3 attempts, each `apt-get update` then `apt-get install -y` under a 120 s bound with a 10 s kill grace, pausing 10 s before the next attempt, which since 2026-10-14-quality-gates first runs a bounded repair, `sudo timeout --kill-after=10 120 dpkg --configure -a` in phase `repair` — a failed repair failing that attempt, the first attempt running no `dpkg` — and starts again from `update`; it exits 0 when an attempt completes, 1 when every attempt failed and 2 on a usage error, never the bound's 124 or 137. The matrix job's `Install apt deps` step, a third-party action, carries `timeout-minutes: 10`, the file's one step timeout. The bound answers the hang of CI run 37673662374, green only at its third attempt after a package-install step hung twice (§3 → Session lifecycle, `session-proof`). Pinned by `test_o_package_installs_are_bounded` and `InstallScriptTest` (§4). Witness: CI run 37985678276 on `6c545ced`, 16 of 16 jobs green at its first attempt — eight jobs ran the script, 10 to 16 s each; the guarded `python3-yaml` call was not reached, PyYAML being on the runner image; the android action step took 5 s.
 Not shown by any run: the bound firing on a real mirror stall, and the step timeout firing — the stand-in tests are the bound's one witness; a bound that fires inside `apt-get install` can leave dpkg interrupted, which the next attempt's repair configures since 2026-10-14-quality-gates — no run has shown it on a real interrupted dpkg, the stand-in tests its one witness. No leg of `ci-leg.sh` calls the script and the dev host never runs it against a package manager (.github/scripts/apt-install.sh:47-50; .github/scripts/apt-install.sh:56-65; .github/scripts/apt-install.sh:67-73; .github/workflows/ci.yml:46; .github/workflows/ci.yml:191; .github/workflows/ci.yml:409) — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-09-audit-corrections-agent-surfaces/report.md
